parts.type: State s a ⟶ State s (State s b)
parts.tooltip: fmap f :: State s a ⟶ State s (State s b)\nfmap f sa = \\s -> let (a, s') = sa s in (f a, s')\nThe state s' passes through untouched; the result is the next State computation, not yet run.

parts.type: State s (State s b) ⟶ State s b
parts.tooltip: join :: State s (State s b) ⟶ State s b — the State-specific part\njoin mm = \\s -> let (m, s') = mm s   -- run the outer computation\n                in  m s'              -- run the inner one with the NEW state s'

ports.tooltip: State s a — a computation: given state s returns (a, s')
f : a ⟶ State s b — user code; given result a, produces a new state computation
State s b — the composed computation; when run it produces (b, s''). Never State s (State s b).
